name: Lamentations
title: Lamentations — Funeral Songs over Zion
tagline: Great is Thy faithfulness — in the rubble.
purpose: Teach holy grief without denying God’s justice or hesed.
christ: Man of sorrows who bears Zion’s curse; mercies new every morning.
spirit: Hope that waits quietly for the LORD (3:24–26).
jesus_in_this_book: Man of sorrows who bears Zion’s curse; mercies new every morning.
how_to_read: Sit in the ash. Do not rush past chapter 1–2 to get to 3.
watchman_charge: Lament what sin destroys. Confess. Wait for the LORD.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
